function.name: us_history_population_by_state_year
function.description: Retrieve historical population data for a specific U.S. state and year. Unlike us_economy_gdp_by_state_year, which retrieves historical GDP data, this retrieves historical population data.

function.name: us_economy_gdp_by_state_year
function.description: Retrieve historical GDP data for a specific U.S. state and year. Unlike us_history_population_by_state_year, which retrieves historical population data, this retrieves historical GDP data.

state.description: The U.S. state for which to retrieve the GDP.

year.description: The year for which to retrieve the GDP.

adjustment.description: The type of adjustment for inflation, 'Real' or 'Nominal'. Optional, 'Nominal' by default.
